generationPrompt: Square 1:1 master for a small passive-item icon in a whimsical fantasy survival game. Stylized 2D storybook cutout, hand-painted but clean, thick deep-plum outer contour, flat matte colors, simple cel shading, bold readable silhouette, low detail, unmistakable at 48 pixels. One centered everyday or magical item fills about 72% of the canvas with generous transparent padding. Genuine transparent background. No frame, no card, no panel, no scene, no ground plane, no baked shadow, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no characters or hands, no photorealism, no 3D render, no pixel art. An open memory book with a soft echo ripple.
